scripts.build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @bruma/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run contracts:build && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.api:dev: npm run contracts:build && npm run dev --workspace @bruma/api
scripts.api:build: npm run contracts:build && npm run build --workspace @bruma/api
scripts.format: prettier --write apps/web/src apps/api/src apps/api/prisma/seed.ts packages/contracts/src tests scripts/**/*.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps/web/src apps/api/src apps/api/prisma/seed.ts packages/contracts/src tests scripts/**/*.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build --workspace @bruma/api
